## 🎯 Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is. 
*Example: "I'm always frustrated when I browse Instagram Reels or LinkedIn posts and cannot verify creators with ExpertSeal..."*

## 💡 Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include UI ideas, workflow changes, or new integrations.

## 🔄 Describe alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, workarounds, or features you've considered.

## 🛠️ Relevant Areas (Select all that apply)
- [ ] New Social Media Platform (e.g., Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, Substack)
- [ ] New LLM Provider / Model (e.g., Anthropic Claude, Groq, Ollama / Local Models)
- [ ] Credential Extraction / Master Prompt Improvement
- [ ] User Interface / UX (Popup, Injected Badges, Drawer / Modal)
- [ ] Community Database & Git Sync
- [ ] Performance, Caching & Privacy

## 📋 Additional context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
